exact_result: The genuine singular-projective mixed E1 operator, raw mass V, probability normalization, translation-normalized energy, finite-dual-energy target characterization, comparison and one-constant uniqueness are reconstructed from BJ. Independent relative-support curve slopes and radial trace equality, determinant traces and fixed slicing weights, ample model atoms, algebraic collars, global FS supports and nonnormal pole-order localization are proved as drafts. Existence and onto normalization remain conditional on actual singular EP.
concrete_gaps: Higher-dimensional relative-image PL inputs still need a complete finite rational-domain representation and calibrated chart application; CLD17.8.4 versus18.8.8 strictness cannot be silently equated.

The full smooth bounded-local mixed theory still needs common genuine representation, intrinsic products, partition/integration-by-parts, exact mass and comparison; smooth weak regularization and the controlled principal-open extension remain conditional.

Rossi arbitrary analytic-neighborhood gluing, split analytic-piece gluing and the full local-projection/Hartogs/Runge/singular induction are not reconstructed; the curve equality alone does not construct the trace extension.
Countable rational singular EP, hence arbitrary-cardinality/real-class EP, unconditional arbitrary-support existence and onto PSH/E1/energy/operator normalization remain unproved.
